mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_report ( job_execution_id, batch_collection_log_id, report_type, source_type, region_code, `year_month`, status ) VALUES ( #{jobExecutionId}, #{batchCollectionLogId}, #{reportType}, #{sourceType}, #{regionCode}, #{yearMonth}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_report SET summary = #{summary}, translated_summary = #{translatedSummary}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_report SET pdf_file_name = #{pdfFileName}, pdf_file_path = #{pdfFilePath}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_report SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_execution_id, batch_collection_log_id, report_type, source_type, region_code, `year_month`, summary, translated_summary, pdf_file_name, pdf_file_path, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM batch_report WHERE id = #{reportId}

SELECT id, job_execution_id, job_name, data_type, region_code, `year_month`, house_type, deal_type, collected_count, skipped_count, failed_count, status, started_at, ended_at FROM batch_collection_log WHERE data_type = 'HOUSE_DEAL' AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
